aaron.rule: Idle marks bodies (breathing), hair, cloth, foliage, smoke, water, cloud and particles. Burst marks the actor, its plausible path, whatever it strikes or sheds, and anything attached to it. Never rigid structure, ground, lettering or the camera. When unsure, leave it unmarked.
